Travel Iowa gives 109 miles; DOT GIS gives 119.14075 miles, and the extracted DOT guide contains both 109 and 119. Used tourism mileage with attribution; scope remains unresolved. Guide text is interleaved in places, so no driving time used.
Driving order follows the supplied strip itinerary, with Guttenberg explicitly a branch. Elkader’s isolated 5.96-mile value does not fit the overall strip sequence; no Elkader moment added.

Dropped current claim calling Gutenberg the inventor of movable type: cached wording repeats it without the geographic qualification needed for accuracy. No other current claim lacks cache text. Motor Mill’s four-mason competition is explicitly a legend and also competes with an intended-addition explanation for the flat wall; omitted rather than resolved.
